limits: Native tests use real UDP plus in-memory test stores; they do not establish MCU execution or flash power-loss safety.

Target archives compile with and without OSCORE. One full unprotected mode-7 ESPHome image links; protected mode-6 archive compiles, and its earlier full image keeps its own source identity.
This image is not installed. Reverse LAN execution requires Windows inbound permission; current shell is not elevated. No firewall or device modification occurred in this software batch.
